summary: Appraise battery storage cash flows, dispatch, degradation, and investment risks. Build a stress-tested business case. Explore the course.
lede: Battery storage economics training helps developers, utility planners, financiers, and consultants assess the commercial case for a storage project. Participants build and stress-test spreadsheet cash flows by examining dispatch and revenue assumptions, capital and operating costs, financing, and degradation. They compare grid-connected and off-grid scenarios and interpret NPV, IRR, and levelized cost of storage (LCOS) to communicate investment risks and sensitivities.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals who appraise, plan, finance, or advise battery storage projects and need to connect operating assumptions with investment decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience with project finance, renewable-energy development, utility planning, or energy project appraisal is useful. You should be comfortable reviewing basic cash-flow assumptions and spreadsheet calculations. No coding is required; advanced price-forecasting and dispatch-optimization topics are covered at an appraisal level.
